text:
amanda: FYI after the namespace-scoped RBAC roll yesterday, staging push to gpu-pool-3 got blocked with a 403 from the deploy-controller. Seen by multiple teams, halting a few CI jobs. :grimacing:

raj: Can you paste the controller logs? Is this the new rolebinding change that scoped deploy permissions to ns=staging only?

amanda: Logs show deploy-controller SA failing KMS decrypt when trying to unwrap model config secret. snippet:```ERROR: KMS Decrypt failed: access denied, keyProject: prod-keys, requester: deploy-controller@staging.svc```

leo: That stack looks like we tightened KMS envelope access as part of least-priv refactor. We moved to per-namespace envelope keys but didn't wire the deploy-controller SA to the key policy.

marie: Confirmed — policy audit shows key "envelope/staging/gpu-models" has no member for the cluster service account. We had assumed the existing rolebinding would propagate, but the KMS binding is independent. :lock:

amanda: Oof. So deploy SA can create Secrets but cannot decrypt envelope to mount on nodes. Customers using staging saw model loads fail, CPU fallback triggered.

raj: Quick mitigation: add the kmsDecrypt permission to the KMS IAM binding for the service account principal:```
projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/envelope/cryptoKeys/envelope-staging: 
  members:
    - serviceAccount:deploy-controller@staging.svc.cluster.local
  roles:
    - roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

leo: Agreed, that's the fastest path. But long-term we should not grant cluster-wide decrypt to deploy-controller — prefer a short-lived decrypt proxy or have node identity do the unwrap.

marie: Also found a subtle RBAC gap: the new namespace-scoped Role forbids reading secrets in kube-system which our node-init job uses to fetch the node key. We need a narrow RoleBinding for just that job.

amanda: Proposed action items: 1) emergency hotfix to KMS binding (grant decrypt to deploy-controller@staging only) 2) create a specific RoleBinding for node-init job to read the particular secret in kube-system 3) add an automated regression in CI that runs a decrypt smoke test after RBAC changes 4) document key-to-SA mapping in the runbook.

raj: I can push the KMS binding change and the RB for node-init. Will send PR and run manual smoke. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Created PR #4512 for KMS binding hotfix (link: https://git.internal/p/r/4512) — awaiting review from @raj and @marie.

security-bot: Audit note created: AUDIT-2026-03-20-07 — RBAC change caused KMS permissions gap in staging; severity: medium; assigned to raj.

leo: Post-mortem: we should add a CI gate that maps SA principals to keys and verifies IAM bindings when RBAC or key policies change. I'll draft a checklist.

amanda: Thanks all. Once PR is merged we'll restart staging deploys and monitor for model load success. :eyes:
